verdict.rationale: SerpApi returns results in open formats (JSON by default, plus raw HTML or Markdown), and the docs mention a Searches Archive API for retrieving past results. That gives a per-search way to pull your data out in portable formats. However, nothing in the evidence documents a bulk 'export all my data' function or an account-exit process. Missing for 10: documented bulk/full-account data export, coverage of non-search account data (billing, settings, history), a documented account deletion/offboarding path, and independent hands-on corroboration of exporting and leaving.
